title: Name WMBT files {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml

facts.note: Primary trigger, independent of task wording: any file identified as a WMBT artifact (by its artifact kind / location in the plan tree or by WMBT-shaped YAML content) is in scope, whatever operation touches it. The rule is an invariant over every WMBT filename.
Covers adding a WMBT file, renaming or moving one (new path/name visible in the diff), and checking or correcting existing WMBT filenames during plan review/validation.

A filename check over all existing WMBT files (pattern match against {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml) is needed to activate the rule for already-present, incorrectly named WMBTs that the current task did not touch.

fires: Planner creates a new WMBT file for a wagon.
Planner renames an existing WMBT file.
Planner moves a WMBT file to another location in the plan tree.
Planner reviews or validates a plan and encounters an existing WMBT file whose name does not match {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml (e.g. carries a prefix), and must correct it.
A task touches WMBT files without mentioning the term 'WMBT' (e.g. 'add the next step for this wagon').
doesNotFire: Editing the contents of an already correctly named WMBT file without changing its name.
Naming acceptance, wagon, or other non-WMBT plan files.

given: A WMBT file exists or is being created, renamed, moved, or reviewed.
when: You choose, change, or check its file name.
then: Ensure the file is named {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml — the step code followed by the sequence number, with no prefix.
prefer: Step-coded names such as E001.yaml, L045.yaml, K023.yaml.
When you find an existing WMBT file with a non-conforming name, rename it to the {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml form.
avoid: Any prefix before the step code (e.g. a 'wmbt-' or wagon-name prefix) — the name must be step-coded with no prefix.
why: The filename is the WMBT URN's step-coded sequence segment, so a predictable {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml name keeps file and URN aligned.
evidence: Every WMBT file name matches {STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml (e.g. E001.yaml, L045.yaml, K023.yaml) with no prefix.
verifier_detail: Term 'filename' = the WMBT file name; values.pattern = '{STEP_CODE}{NNN}.yaml'. STEP_CODE comes from the step-code vocabulary (planner.wmbt.step-code-vocabulary); NNN is the sequence number, shown as three digits in all source examples (E001, L045, K023). No prefix allowed. Check applies to all WMBT files present, not only those changed in the diff.
